## Why This Is Asked
This question probes ability to design a production-grade streaming cca_score pipeline on Databricks, focusing on late-arrival tolerance, idempotency, exact-once semantics, and poisoning resistance, plus API design and test strategy.

## Key Concepts
- Delta Live Tables and Structured Streaming for real-time processing
- Watermarking and late data handling
- Exactly-once guarantees and deduplication
- Secure aggregation and drift/poisoning detection
- Idempotent API design and test planning

## Code Example
```javascript
// Pseudocode: Spark Structured Streaming
val df = spark.readStream.format("json").load("/scores")
val keyed = df.withColumn("key", concat(col("device_id"), lit("_"), col("region")))
val aggr = keyed.groupBy(window(col("timestamp"), "1s"), col("key")).agg(sum("share_blob").as("agg_blob"))
aggr.writeStream.format("delta").option("checkpointLocation","/cp/cca").start("/delta/cca_score")
``` 

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you audit data lineage and rollback a bad window without affecting past results?
- How would you adapt the flow for multi-tenant isolation and DP budgets?

## Why This Is Asked
Assesses ability to design multi-tenant, hardware-attested, versioned scoring pipelines with safe migrations and robust auditing for privacy-preserving systems.

## Key Concepts
- Hardware attestation integration across multiple TPM providers
- Versioned policy enforcement and schema evolution
- End-to-end provenance tracking per attestation
- Replay protection and tamper-evidence mechanisms
- Cross-version compatibility and safe rollback procedures

## Testing Strategy

### Attestation Integrity Testing
- Replay attack prevention using nonce-based challenges
- Signature validation across different TPM manufacturers
- Attestation blob tamper detection with cryptographic hash verification
- Cross-TPM compatibility testing with known good attestation samples

### Cross-Version Compatibility Testing
- Automated schema migration testing between policy versions
- Backward compatibility verification for legacy client submissions
- Score consistency validation across policy version boundaries
- Integration testing with sandboxed TPM emulators

### Audit and Rollback Strategy
- Immutable audit log for all attestation submissions and policy changes
- Time-bound rollback windows with automatic health check validation
- Canary deployments with real-time monitoring of attestation success rates
- Emergency rollback triggers with attestation replay verification

    region: request.region,

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudo: compute trimmed-mean delta from windowed deltas
function trimmedMean(deltas, trim = 0.1) {
  deltas.sort((a,b)=>a-b)
  const n = deltas.length
  const k = Math.floor(n * trim)
  const slice = deltas.slice(k, n - k)
  const sum = slice.reduce((a,b)=>a+b, 0)
  return sum / slice.length
}
```
